name: hand-drawn-diagrams
title_zh: 默认单色草图，页面稿才许你点彩
tagline_zh: 画流程图、线框、架构图、讲解图，默认铅笔质感单色输出，不花哨不抢戏。只有你要网页级还原时，才克制地放开颜色。
tagline_en: Flowcharts, wireframes, architecture maps — all come out as clean pencil-style monochrome sketches. Color stays.
desc_en: Create hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams, flows, explainers, wireframes, and page mockups. Default to monochrome sketch output; allow restrained color only for page mockups when the user explicitly wants webpage-like fidelity. Use when the user asks for a diagram, flowchart, wireframe, sketch, visual explanation, mind map, architecture overview, or any Excalidraw-based drawing.
why_zh: 把「好看」的默认权从模型手里夺回来——单色草图让结构先说话，颜色变成你主动申请的稀缺资源。
why_en: It flips the default: structure speaks first in monochrome, and color becomes a scarce resource you must explicitly request.
limit_zh: 只认 Excalidraw 格式，不产出 SVG/PNG 成品图。单色是硬默认，你要彩色得逐次明说，模型不会自己猜。
limit_en: Excalidraw format only — no SVG/PNG exports. Monochrome is a hard default; color requires explicit per-request opt-in. Won't force itself onto.
title_en: Monochrome sketch by default; color only for page mockups
